info.title: 10ML Fragrance Index API
info.description: Free perfume API and fragrance notes API from the 10ML Fragrance Index: 6,000+ perfumes and 249 houses with note pyramids, accords, families, similar scents, alternatives from other houses, notes explained and guides, curated by 10ML's fragrance editors. The same answers as the 10ML Perfume Finder MCP server at https://mcp.10ml.com/mcp. No API key, no sign-up, read-only JSON over GET.

get.description: Search the 10ML Fragrance Index for perfumes, colognes and fragrances (eau de parfum, eau de toilette, extrait) by name, house, notes, accords, family, audience, season, occasion or style. Natural language works: 'fresh citrus summer cologne for men' or 'warm vanilla scent for winter' is understood. Set iconic to true for only the editors' iconic, era-defining classics ('must-know perfumes for her', 'iconic winter scents'). Use when someone describes the scent they want, or names a perfume or house and you need matching fragrances. Not for the full profile of one known perfume (use get_perfume), not for 'something like X' (use find_similar_perfumes) and not for dupes or alternatives to a famous perfume (use find_perfume_alternatives). Returns ranked perfumes with house, year, family, accords, key notes, an editorial character line and 10ml.com links.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Free text: a perfume name, house, notes or mood. Examples: "fresh citrus summer for men", "Tom Ford oud", "vanilla gourmand for winter"

parameters.name: house
parameters.description: Only perfumes from this house. Examples: "Dior", "Maison Francis Kurkdjian", "MFK", "YSL"

parameters.name: notes_include
parameters.description: Every listed note must be present. Examples: ["oud","sandalwood"], ["vanilla"] Comma-separated list.

parameters.name: notes_exclude
parameters.description: None of these notes may be present. Example: ["patchouli"] Comma-separated list.

parameters.name: accords
parameters.description: Accords that must be present. Examples: ["woody","sweet"], ["fresh","aquatic"] Comma-separated list.

parameters.name: family
parameters.description: Fragrance family. Examples: "chypre", "fougere", "gourmand", "amber", "citrus". Leave term empty in explain_perfume_term to list every family.

parameters.name: gender
parameters.description: Audience the perfume is marketed to. men and women also include unisex perfumes.

parameters.name: season
parameters.description: Season the perfume suits (fall is accepted in text queries as autumn).

parameters.name: occasion
parameters.description: Occasion the perfume suits.

parameters.name: style
parameters.description: A style word the scent should have.

parameters.name: iconic
parameters.description: true = only the editors' iconic, era-defining classics (works with every other filter, and without a query)

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Results per page.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: next_cursor from the previous page.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: concise (default) or detailed (adds pyramid, seasons, occasions, longevity).

parameters.name: locale
parameters.description: Language of the 10ml.com links and labels.

total.description: How many results matched in all

next_cursor.description: Pass as cursor to get the next page; absent on the last page

message.description: Guidance when the result is empty, partial or needs a follow-up tool

key_notes.description: The defining notes (empty when no pyramid is published)

url.description: A 10ml.com link in the requested locale

other_versions.description: Ids of other concentrations or flankers of the same perfume in the index

filters.description: The filters applied, including ones read from the query text

relaxed.description: True when no perfume matched every word and the closest partial matches are shown

get.description: The full Fragrance Index profile of one perfume, cologne or fragrance: house, launch year, audience, concentration, family, accords, note pyramid (top, heart and base notes), best seasons and occasions, longevity, projection and perfumers (full profiles), the editors' character description, five similar perfumes, editorial alternatives from other houses when they exist, related 10ML guides and links. Use when you know which perfume is meant and need facts about it ('tell me about Aventus', 'what notes are in Delina', 'what does Baccarat Rouge 540 smell like'). Not for browsing (use search_perfumes), not for comparing two or more (use compare_perfumes). Unknown names return the closest matches.

get.description: Find perfumes and colognes that smell like one the person already likes, ranked by shared notes, accords and style, each saying exactly what it shares and how close it is (very close, similar vibe, same spirit). Works from a perfume in the index (name and house, or id) OR from free notes/accords for any other fragrance. Steer the result: fresher, sweeter, darker, lighter, longer_lasting or more_projection. Use for 'something like Baccarat Rouge 540', 'smells like Sauvage but fresher' or 'a scent with saffron and cedar'. Not for editorial dupes of a famous perfume from other houses (use find_perfume_alternatives) and not for free-text discovery (use search_perfumes).

parameters.name: perfume

parameters.name: accords

parameters.name: steer
parameters.description: Move away from the starting point in one direction: fresher, sweeter, darker, lighter, longer_lasting (needs a perfume in the index) or more_projection (same).

get.summary: Find alternatives to a perfume from other houses
get.description: The editors' alternatives (dupes) to a famous perfume or cologne, from other houses: for each, why it is close and how close (very close, similar vibe, same spirit), plus the 10ML guide that compares them. Covers about 100 iconic originals such as Creed Aventus, Baccarat Rouge 540, Delina, Sauvage, Black Opium or Santal 33. For other fragrances in the index the closest options from different houses are computed from notes and accords. Use for 'dupe of X', 'alternative to X', 'what smells like X from another house'. Not for general similarity inside the index (use find_similar_perfumes) and not for free-text discovery (use search_perfumes).

Not for listing every perfume with the note (use perfumes_by_note) and not for general terms like EDP or sillage (use explain_perfume_term).

get.description: Find 10ML's perfume and fragrance guides to read or cite: how-tos (where to spray, finding a signature scent, making perfume last), notes explained, house guides, lists, and alternatives guides that compare famous perfumes with similar ones from other houses. Returns title, type and a link per locale. Use whenever you want a source to cite or a deeper read ('how to layer perfume', 'best oud perfumes', 'Creed Aventus dupes guide'). Not for facts about a perfume (use get_perfume) and not for note definitions (use explain_note).
